steps.name: 01-help-vstart
stdout: usage: kathara vstart [-h] [--noterminals | --terminals | --num_terms NUM_TERMS] [--privileged] -n DEVICE_NAME [--eth N:CD/MAC [N:CD/MAC ...]] [-e [EXEC_COMMANDS ...]] [--mem MEM] [--cpus CPUS]
[-i IMAGE] [--no-hosthome | --hosthome] [--terminal-emu TERMINAL_EMU] [--print] [--bridged] [--port [HOST:]GUEST[/PROTOCOL] [[HOST:]GUEST[/PROTOCOL] ...]]
[--sysctl SYSCTL [SYSCTL ...]] [--env ENV [ENV ...]] [--ulimit KEY=SOFT[:HARD] [KEY=SOFT[:HARD] ...]] [--volume HOST|GUEST|[MODE] [HOST|GUEST|[MODE] ...]] [--shell SHELL]
[--entrypoint ENTRYPOINT]
Start a new Kathara device
positional arguments:
ARG                   Specify extra arguments for the entrypoint command.
options:
-h, --help            Show a help message and exit.
--noterminals         Start the device without opening a terminal window.
--terminals           Start the device opening its terminal window.
--num_terms NUM_TERMS
Choose the number of terminals to open for the device.
--privileged          Start the device in privileged mode. MUST BE ROOT FOR THIS OPTION.
-n, --name DEVICE_NAME
Name of the device to be started.
--eth N:CD/MAC [N:CD/MAC ...]
Set a specific interface on a collision domain.
-e, --exec [EXEC_COMMANDS ...]
Execute a specific command in the device during startup.
--mem MEM             Limit the amount of RAM available for this device.
--cpus CPUS           Limit the amount of CPU available for this device.
-i, --image IMAGE     Run this device with a specific Docker Image.
--no-hosthome, -H     Do not mount "/hosthome" directory inside the device.
--hosthome            Mount "/hosthome" directory inside the device.
--terminal-emu TERMINAL_EMU
Set a different terminal emulator application (Unix only).
--print, --dry-run    Check if the device parameters are correct (dry run).
--bridged             Add a bridge interface to the device.
--port [HOST:]GUEST[/PROTOCOL] [[HOST:]GUEST[/PROTOCOL] ...]
Map localhost port HOST to the internal port GUEST of the device for the specified PROTOCOL.
--sysctl SYSCTL [SYSCTL ...]
Set sysctl option for the device.
--env ENV [ENV ...]   Set environment variable for the device.
--ulimit KEY=SOFT[:HARD] [KEY=SOFT[:HARD] ...]
Set ulimit for the device.
--volume HOST|GUEST|[MODE] [HOST|GUEST|[MODE] ...]
Specify a volume to mount.
--shell SHELL         Set the shell (sh, bash, etc.) that should be used inside the device.
--entrypoint ENTRYPOINT
Specify the entrypoint command of the device.
For examples and further information visit: https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki

steps.name: 02-help-vconfig
stdout: usage: kathara vconfig [-h] -n DEVICE_NAME (--add CD/MAC [CD/MAC ...] | --rm CD [CD ...])
Manage the network interfaces of a running Kathara device
options:
-h, --help            Show a help message and exit.
-n, --name DEVICE_NAME
Name of the device to be connected on desired collision domains.
--add CD/MAC [CD/MAC ...]
Specify the collision domain to add.
--rm CD [CD ...]      Specify the collision domain to remove.
For examples and further information visit: https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki

steps.name: 03-help-vclean
stdout: usage: kathara vclean [-h] -n DEVICE_NAME
Stop a single Kathara device
options:
-h, --help            Show a help message and exit.
-n, --name DEVICE_NAME
The name of the device to clean.
For examples and further information visit: https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki
